## Problem

Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe it clearly and concisely. For example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed outcome

Describe the feature you would like to see and how it should work.

## Why it matters

Explain how this feature improves the workflow for Soroban/Stellar developers using WeighIn.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional context

Add any other context, screenshots, or sample data about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and discussions for a similar request.
- [ ] I have described the benefit to WeighIn users, not just to my own use case.
